purpose: VibeVoice-ASR WER harness validation + hipEngine/torch transcript parity (single-speaker subset)
hardware: AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ PRO 395, Radeon 8060S (gfx1151)
caveats: all 50 clips are speaker 1089, one chapter, clean read speech - a parity check, not an accuracy gate vs the published multi-speaker 2.20% row
both lanes used the matched frozen-request bench protocol; greedy, max_new_tokens 256, 24 kHz PCM resampled from 16 kHz FLAC (scipy)
0.01% WER = ~1 word error in 977 words; refs differ from hyps only by case/punctuation before normalization
a diverse 23-speaker 50-clip gate run is in flight and will supersede this artifact as the accuracy gate
diff_analysis: 20/50 transcripts differ, all in punctuation, capitalization or possessive artifacts ('Shelley's's' vs 'Shelley's', comma placement); per-clip WER differs on 4/50 and in all four hipEngine is cleaner (torch made double-possessive and one wrong-word error, hip 0.0). Differences are bf16-vs-fp16 GEMM rounding divergence on ambiguous tokens; no systematic hipEngine degradation.
